sequence.description: The log's head once the command committed: its last event, or the head it saw when it appended none.

changed.description: False for a command that was accepted and changed nothing, so appended no event.

sequence.description: The log's head when the command was rejected.

reason.description: Why the command was rejected, the code of its error: not_found when its target does not exist.

code.description: A stable error code in snake case.

error.description: The rejection as an error: its code (the reason), a message for people and structured data.

receipt.description: A command's receipt: accepted (with the head sequence after it and whether it changed anything) or rejected (with the reason and the error). A retry with the same commandId answers the same receipt.

result.description: The method's result, present when this request applied the command; absent on a retry and on a rejection.

name.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

anyOf.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

accountId.description: The account the choice is for; null for the whole environment, whose choice outranks an account's.

enabled.description: Whether the name is on: off leaves it out of the set whichever layers hold it.

oneOf.description: A name switched off, or on again, for one account or the whole environment.

name.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

accountId.description: The account whose runs append the member.

on.description: Whether every run of the account appends the member's body.

oneOf.description: A name made always-on, or not, for one account.

choice.description: The choice as the environment holds it now.
